note: Vendored copies of the com.etzhayyim.manabi lexicons this app's constitutional gate tests assert against. Vendored — not referenced across repos — because a test that reads a sibling west project cannot run for anyone who clones only this repo, and cannot run in fleet CI at all (fleet ships one repo's tree). A test that cannot run reports the same 'nothing wrong' as a test that ran and found nothing.
drift_policy: tests/g18-lexicon-provenance.test.ts recomputes these digests. If you edit a vendored lexicon, the digest test goes red on purpose: change the upstream contract first, then re-vendor and update this file.
